column6: {04:FF}様！\n我らを救{08:52}下さ{08:52}、本当に有り難う御座い{08:5A}！！\n<wait>

column6: 貴方がい{08:57}、{08:47}{08:10}は全滅{08:4A}いたに\n違いありません。\n<wait>

column6: 本当に有り難う御座い{08:5A}！！\n<wait>

column6: 新宿に{08:3F}程しっかり{08:4B}拠点が出来ちまうと、\n{08:47}辺りも、かなりやばく{08:1A}来る‥‥‥‥\n<wait>
column7: With what's happening over at Shinjuku,\nit's only a matter of time till disaster strikes here...\n<wait>
column8: reads: 新宿にあれ程しっかりした拠点が出来ちまうと、\nこの辺りも、かなりやばくなって来る‥‥‥‥\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: It's not like we can move to the surface. Not anymore.\nI wonder, what are we going to do going forward?...\n
column8: reads: 今更、俺たちは外では暮らせないし‥‥‥\nどうしたらいいんだ。\n @from-v005

column7: Aah! Mister Katsuragi! I owe you my life! Thank you!\n<wait>
